Pop Off Quirk.name: Pop Off Quirk
Pop Off Quirk.description:
🟣 You have sticky scalp balls that trap others and bounce you away.

🌱 At the start you pluck and throw a ball across a classroom, slow one person with a few placed balls or bounce off them for a short jump.
📈 With training: capture patterns, safe routes over broken ground, repeated rescue jumps, broad barriers that keep crowds away from danger.
⚠️ You bleed if you pluck too many; balls lose their hold over time, cannot release on command, and can trap allies until they fade or stuck material is removed.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Bodily Toll, as excessive plucking injures your scalp.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Minoru Mineta's Pop Off. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sticky Toss, Scalp Spring
Pop Off Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: sticky scalp balls, plucked and thrown. Start: classroom-length throws onto clothing or solid surfaces; several impede a person or mark a route. Others stick; the user rebounds for short jumps, quick turns. Elaborate traps, longer routes need training.
Limits: overplucking bleeds, then stops safe plucking. Strong but temporary hold, varying with condition. Targets can dodge, cut free or skirt traps. Balls cannot fly, chase, reshape or release on command; they block allies and rescuers until the hold fades or the material is removed.
Quirk Strain: light: throw, rebound; moderate: capture cluster, crossing; heavy: broad trap, repeated rescue jumps; severe: signature field, block-scale placement.
Drawback: built in, the canon Bodily Toll.
Canon: Minoru Mineta's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: user answers for balls that trap bystanders or block rescuers.
Look: scalp balls.
